llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed markdown-only workflow for saving useful PR review lessons into a project memory system.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture, organize, and retrieve PR review findings, and the artifacts consistently describe review-chamber rooms, scoring criteria, search, and related indexing for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill describes both manual capture and an automatic post-review hook, but the actions are limited to evaluating PR review findings and adding/searching entries in the project palace.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only markdown skill instructions and modules; no executable installer, hidden script, autostart file, or package install path was present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may persist PR discussion details, participant names, file paths, suggested fixes, tags, and optional embedding/search indexes, which is proportionate to searchable institutional PR-review memory but should be scoped to intended projects.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistent review entries, backlinks, indexes, caches, and possible background index updates are disclosed as part of the memory-palace workflow; no credential use, destructive action, or privileged system access was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want PR review decisions and lessons saved into a searchable project memory. Be aware that it can retain review content, reviewer names, file references, and architectural/security findings, so use it only in repositories where storing that institutional knowledge is appropriate.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact inspection also found only purpose-aligned markdown guidance.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[staticScan] expected: The static scan reported no suspicious patterns, matching the artifact evidence of a documentation-only skill.
